name: Ace Engitech Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1991, Ace Engitech Limited (formerly Prem Somani Financial Services Limited) provides IT services
keyPoints:
Change in Business:[1]
Company used to be an NBFC but RBI cancelled Certificate of Registration vide Order dated October 18th 2018 due to non maintenance of minimum Net Owned Fund and no NBFC related activities being carried out by company. On August 9th 2021, company changed its objects from financial activities to IT Technologies and web designing related activities

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of -43.5% over last 3 years.
